children: NBT Bancorp reported record third-quarter 2026 net income of $58.0 million, or $1.11 per diluted share, compared with $54.5 million and $1.03 per share a year earlier. Operating diluted earnings per share was $1.11, while net interest margin on a fully taxable equivalent basis rose to 3.78%. The board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share.
Net income was $58.0 million, up from $54.5 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Diluted earnings per share was $1.11, compared with $1.03 a year earlier; operating diluted earnings per share was also $1.11.
Net interest income was $142.1 million, up 5.5% year over year. Fully taxable equivalent net interest income was $142.7 million, and net interest margin was 3.78%.
Noninterest income, excluding securities gains, was $52.9 million, up 2.9% year over year. The company said revenues increased 4.5% from the prior quarter.
The board declared a $0.40-per-share dividend, an 8.1% increase over the dividend paid in the third quarter of 2025.
Period-end loans increased 3.0% from December 31, 2025; excluding the planned run-off portfolios of other consumer and residential solar loans, they rose 3.9%.
Deposits increased from year-end, with a shift toward demand deposits, interest-bearing checking, savings and money market accounts, partly offset by lower time deposits.

Nonperforming assets rose during the quarter, primarily reflecting additional commercial lending relationships placed on nonaccrual status and more residential past-due loans. Past-due loans decreased from the prior quarter.
NBT repurchased 20,118 shares during the quarter and continued purchases under its existing stock repurchase plan after quarter-end.
